input: Pump P-203 seal is leaking on the discharge side, small drip, please schedule this week.
URGENT: compressor K-101 tripped on high vibration twice tonight, operations running on standby unit.
Transmitter TT-308 reading frozen at 370 degC, suspect wiring. Not safety related.
Control valve FV-212 sticking, loop oscillating, operators put it in manual.
Motor M-415 running hot, 85 degC on the casing, no trip yet. Check at next opportunity.
Heat exchanger E-120 outlet temperature dropping, probable fouling. Plan cleaning at turnaround.
PSV-130A lifted below set pressure during startup. Safety device, needs immediate review.
Level transmitter LT-244 drifting compared with the sight glass by about 8%.
Breaker on feeder for pump P-310 tripped, pump is stopped, process on bypass. Asap please.
Noise from gearbox of agitator A-205, sounds like bearing wear. Monitor and plan replacement.
pH analyzer AT-118 needs recalibration, readings 0.5 pH off the lab sample.
Small oil leak under compressor K-102 lube oil skid, contained in drip tray. Low priority.
Flow transmitter FT-104 shows 0 m3/h while the pump is running, signal at 3.5 mA.
Insulation damaged on steam line near exchanger E-330, burn risk for operators.
Motor M-120 vibration slightly above baseline on last route, trend it.
Pressure transmitter PT-301 cover missing, enclosure open to rain.
Control valve FV-104 positioner air leak, valve still controlling but noisy.
Pump P-122 cavitating at low flow, impeller damage suspected. Urgent, only spare unit available.
Breaker for the motor of agitator A-110 keeps tripping on start, agitator stopped.
Temperature transmitter TT-124 intermittent bad quality alarms on the DCS, maybe loose terminal.
